title: State Machine Replication via Raft Consensus
explanation: State Machine Replication ensures that identical server replicas process the exact same sequence of commands to maintain consistent application state across distributed nodes. Raft achieves this by electing a single leader responsible for managing log replication. The leader accepts client write requests, appends them to its log, and broadcasts AppendEntries RPCs to follower nodes. Once a majority of followers acknowledge the entry, the leader commits the log and applies it to its local state machine, subsequently notifying followers to commit the same entry during their next heartbeat cycle.
takeaway: Implementing robust consensus protocols prevents split brain scenarios and split state corruption, guaranteeing fault tolerant coordination across distributed cloud infrastructure without sacrificing availability.
